newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mostly higher.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended mostly higher on Wednesday, as local investors were encouraged by bullish sentiment of the CBOT corn futures market overnight, traders said.
The spot November was up 350 yen at 19,370 yen per tonne. And the benchmark September was down 10 yen at 18,400 yen.
U.S. corn output estimates for 1996 of 8.2 billion bushels by the Professional Farmers of America was still a bullish factor for the Chicago and Tokyo markets, the traders said.
"Some traders are doubtful about the Professional Farmers estimates. But it was a bullish factor anyway," a trader said.
The spot September contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.69-1/2 per bushel at 0645 GMT against $3.69-3/4 at Tuesday's close.
The September contract on the CBOT soybean project A trading system was being traded at $8.26 at the same time, against $8.24 at Tuesday's close.
